subject: Compliance onboarding: ISO/FedRAMP timeline and evidence requests
messages:
From: Jane Dawson <jane.dawson@quantumbank.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + compliance roadmap questions

Hi Rafael,

Thanks for the conversation earlier. As we evaluate Redwood for a pilot, our security team asked for a short compliance roadmap so they can map requirements to our procurement timeline. High level asks:

- Current attestations (SOC 2 type II, ISO 27001 status) and expected dates if in progress.
- FedRAMP readiness posture (are you targeting a FedRAMP-authorized path or supporting customers through an AWS/FedRAMP baseline?)
- Expected audit windows for the next 12 months and any upcoming evidence collection windows.
- Preferred format for SIG/CAIQ responses and whether you provide a completed SIG spreadsheet or a self-service portal.

We need this by EOD Wednesday so our InfoSec can schedule a short review. If convenient, loop in the compliance person who can answer timeline details.

Thanks,
Jane
Jane Dawson
Director, Cloud Security Evaluation
Quantum Bank

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Jane Dawson <jane.dawson@quantumbank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + compliance roadmap questions

Hi Jane — great to meet you earlier. Looping in Marissa (Head of Compliance) and Grace (Customer Success lead for financials). See a compact summary below and a few clarifying Qs so we can tailor the deliverable by Wednesday.

Quick summary:
- SOC 2: Type II, most recent report audited for period Dec 2025–Nov 2026; next Type II audit currently scheduled for Q4 2027 (fieldwork planned Oct 2027). We can provide the executive SOC 2 summary PDF and a redacted report under an NDA.
- ISO 27001: Certification in progress — external audit readiness review planned Aug 2027; target certification date Q1 2028 pending remediation items.
- FedRAMP: We are not currently a FedRAMP-authorized service provider. For regulated customers, we operate in a FedRAMP-aligned architecture on AWS GovCloud where requested and provide evidence to customers during their FedRAMP assessments. We do not claim an Authority to Operate.
- SIG/CAIQ: We maintain a completed SIG intake spreadsheet and can provide CAIQ mappings. Preferred delivery: we can send a pre-filled SIG spreadsheet and an accompanying control narrative PDF.

Clarifying questions to help prioritize the packet:
1) Do you need full control narratives or just short evidence pointers (log locations, retention commitments, sample artifacts)?
2) Are you planning to include Redwood in a FedRAMP authorization package or use Redwood under a customer-hosted model?
3) Any particular controls of concern (encryption at rest, key management, multi-tenant isolation requests)?

We'll attach the concise artifacts (SOC 2 exec summary, ISO roadmap snapshot, SIG template) and a one-pager timeline. Marissa — can you confirm the ISO milestone dates below and attach the SIG/CAIQ spreadsheet? Grace — can you note if there are known procurement gating items we should call out for a bank (e.g., local data residency requests or custom logging SLA)?

Best,
Rafael
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jane Dawson <jane.dawson@quantumbank.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 17:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + compliance roadmap questions

Hi Jane — quick note from compliance. Attached are the items Rafael mentioned:
- redwood-soc2-summary-2027.pdf (executive summary, redacted opinion available under NDA)
- redwood-iso27001-roadmap-2027.xlsx (milestones and owners)
- SIG-Cert-Response-Template.xlsx (pre-filled answers for common SIG/CAIQ questions; marked where evidence is required)

Short answers to your clarifying questions:
1) We can provide short evidence pointers by default (log type, retention windows, sample artifact name). For high-risk controls we will supply control narratives and sample artifacts upon request and an NDA.
2) We support customers pursuing FedRAMP by providing architecture diagrams, encryption/key management details, and evidence extracts; we do not host an ATO but have a documented FedRAMP-aligned pattern for customers to reference.
3) Controls commonly flagged by financial customers include: encryption key separation (we integrate with customer KMS via BYOK for dedicated deployments), access review cadence evidence, and log retention snapshots. These are all documented in the attached SIG sheet.

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary-2027.pdf; redwood-iso27001-roadmap-2027.xlsx; SIG-Cert-Response-Template.xlsx

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Compliance | Redwood Inference
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Jane Dawson <jane.dawson@quantumbank.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + compliance roadmap questions

Hi Jane — thanks, I added a short procurement checklist below tailored to banking procurement teams. Rafael — feel free to surface this alongside the attachments.

Procurement gating checklist (banking focus):
- NDA + redacted SOC 2 (legal sign-off)
- Data residency confirmation for production pilot (region/azs)
- KMS integration plan if BYOK is required (owner: infra eng)
- SLAs: token-level logging retention and breach notification windows (we provide configurable retention; default 90 days)
- Pen test / vulnerability disclosure support: proof of recent pentest and remediation ETA

If you want, we can schedule a 30-min deep-dive with our security engineer to walk the SIG spreadsheet next week. What times work for your InfoSec?

Regards,
Grace
Senior CSM, Financials | Redwood Inference
From: Jane Dawson <jane.dawson@quantumbank.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, security@quantumbank.com
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + compliance roadmap questions

Rafael / team — this is perfect, thank you. Quantum Bank would like:

- The pre-filled SIG spreadsheet and SOC 2 exec summary now (we've received the attachments).
- A 30-min SIG walkthrough with your security engineer next Tuesday (23 Mar) at 10:00 AM PT. Can you confirm and send a calendar invite?
- For ISO, please confirm the external readiness review date (you listed Aug 2027) and whether that means certification docs will be available to customers for Q1 2028 planning.

Also, we require a scoped redacted SOC 2 report under our standard NDA prior to procurement committee approval. Who is our NDA contact at Redwood?

I'll await the calendar invite and NDA contact.

Best,
Jane
Jane Dawson
Director, Cloud Security Evaluation
Quantum Bank
